physicalEvidence.summary: Full May 2026 VBT-MPC uses a trained U-Net++/ResNet18 segmenter, line fitting and EKF to extract tactile contours, then classical constrained MPC commands a real Kinova Gen3 with GelSight Mini. Physical tests include printed corners and household objects, at50Hz control with15fps tactile images. Accuracy worsens on ambiguous or deformable contours. Current ACP doctoral student Luis Recalde is co-first author with an Alicante researcher. This is a current WPI–Alicante collaboration; the paper does not independently establish that the apparatus is at WPI, so shared-hardware credit is capped20. Other physical aerial MPC demos are not automatically neural methods.

shortVisit.summary: Current ACP contact page welcomes PhD, postdoc and visiting-scholar inquiries by email with CV/transcript and an important prior paper if available. Its separate project form is explicitly for WPI students. The visiting label provides an inquiry path but does not establish outside-master eligibility, summer2027 capacity, duration, funding or remote options. The roster’s high-school intern is not a master’s precedent.
